faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any persons to dump, deposit or dispose of any glass, paper,
               can, bottle, box, garbage, or any other trash whatsoever anywhere on any street, alley,
               road, highway, parking lot, public or community building, or any private property
               open to the general public except in a trash receptacle provided for such purpose.
(b)
Littering shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1981, § 21-31; Ord. No. 2367, § 1, 11-3-1986)
Cross reference—
Littering in parks, § 66-10; solid waste,
ch. 90
.
State Law reference—
Littering of public or private property, C.R.S. § 18-4-511.
